NVS Class 9th Online Form 2027 – Extend – Full Details

Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has released a notification for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class IX (2027 – 2028) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 9 Online Form 2026 has started from 02 September 2026 & the candidate Can apply till the 15 October 2026. The entrance examination will be held on 10 April 2027. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 9th Online form 2026 direct link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 15 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 10 April 2027
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
